correctness.rationale: Laurent–Nogueira's known rational plateau criterion L_{p,q}(λ)≤b≤U_{p,q}(λ) is explicitly credited. Monotonicity of the degree-one lift in λ implies both rational boundary functions are nonincreasing and, by analyticity/nonconstancy, strictly decreasing from 1 to p/q. Hence unique α,β for p/q<b<1 and none for b≤p/q. Independent exact floor-sum/quotient derivative calculations checked L′(1)=−(q−1)/(2q), U′(1)=−(q+1)/(2q) for all coprime 2≤q<16. Strong-contraction expansion uses first missing Sturmian coefficient at m=ceil(q/(q−p))−1, then mean value theorem yields (1/m)ε^((q−m)/m) width when p≤q−2; p=q−1 has distinct ε^(1/q) width. q=2 boundary verified through separate case. Finite checker inspected; universal result rests on cited exact criterion and proved coefficient combinatorics.
